page.layout: One column of running text, with no marginal notes; the left and right edges carry only cut-off print from the neighbouring page and show-through. Page number at the top right. Catchword at the foot right.

main_text.l: basilæ, Simeon Thessalonicensis, Ioseph-
i Bryennius, & Philagrius, Marcus Ephesius,
& alij schisma propugnarunt, in Roma-
nam Ecclesiam inuecti sunt, magnæ apud
Græcos schismaticos existimationis Viri.
Nullus ex his in catalogum Sanctorum re-
latus est, licet relati sint, qui Pontificiam di-
gnitatem agnouerunt, & vnionem cum illa
conseruarunt ad vltimum vsque spiritum.
Hoc certe magnum est, & forte id non con-
fiderauit, sicut & alia multa, Hottingerus.
Inspice Græcorum Sanctorum catalogum,
reuolue libros Rituales illius Ecclesiæ, in-
terroga Critopulum illum tuum, cuius au-
thoritati tantum defers. Quare fateasimilis ne-
cesse est, dum hæc scriberes, te vel sopore
solutum, vel in maxima veritatis ignora-
tione versatum fuisse. Probas id de Pala-
ma ex mea Græcia Orthodoxa pag. 809.
Hic etiam schismaticos sequeris, quorum
ductu necesse est, vt persæpe in mendacia
decidas. Vellem in apertis, & manifestis
non impegisses. Quare antequam protulis-
ses sententiam, allata ibi ab Allatio oculis
apertis non lectitasti? Ibi collocatæ sunt
sententiæ in Palamam a nonnullis Græ-
corum in numerum Sanctorum ascitum.
Nonnulli Græcorum non sunt vniuersi Græ-
ci, nec ipsa Ecclesia Græca. Titulum se

page.notes: Catchword "quun-" printed alone at the lower right, set off from the last line. The first line of the page starts with a word fragment ("basilæ"), so the paragraph continues from the previous page. The word "fatearis" in the scan is partly obscured where the line ends; I have read it as "fateasimilis", which is doubtful and should be checked against the scan. Likewise "schismaticos" in the fourth paragraph and "Inspice" are read from the scan with long s rendered as s. Margins contain no readable notes.
